general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.javascript_file_format: All frontend react files must be Javascript (.js / .jsx).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.bilingual_support: Full EN and FR internationalization strings across all user facing components, buttons, error messages, and admin content fields.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant contrast (minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text, 3:1 for large display text and interactive focus states). Focus ring indicator on keyboard tab navigation.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.notifications: Use Sonner toast notifications (located in src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or src/components/ui/sonner.js) for copy feedback, payment success, and settings update.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind text or dropdown menus. Always apply high opacity backdrop blurs (e.g., bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-stone-200).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build the frontend components in React (.js / .jsx) using Tailwind CSS and standard Radix/Shadcn UI primitives located in frontend/src/components/ui/.
2. Ensure header has logo placeholder, language switcher (EN/FR), login/logout, dashboard and admin menu links.
3. Ensure every form input, button, table row, tab, and card uses data-testid attributes for automated testing.
4. Add Sonner toast notifications for user interactions (e.g., code copied, gift created, login success).
5. Use warm earthy colors (#FAF7F2 background, #D95D39 warm saffron primary, #2A4736 deep forest green secondary, stone-800 text) to evoke the serene, welcoming Art of Living aesthetic.
6. Make DEMO payment clearly marked with DEMO labels as requested.
